title: A Framework for AI-Ready Data in Earth and Environmental Science
abstract: arXiv:2611.27313v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Artificial intelligence (AI), specifically machine learning (ML), is increasingly integral to Earth and environmental research, yet the suitability of current research data infrastructures for supporting AI workflows remains poorly defined. While the FAIR principles provide a foundation for scientific data management, they do not explicitly address several requirements arising when datasets are used for training, evaluating, and deploying AI models. This article presents a practically motivated framework for assessing and improving AI-readiness of research data within distributed Earth and environmental data infrastructures. The framework was developed through a structured, community-driven process, beginning with a review of existing literature and readiness frameworks combined with feedback from a limited survey of scientists applying ML methods. translated_title: 地球与环境科学中AI就绪数据的评估框架
translated_abstract: 人工智能（AI），特别是机器学习（ML），在地球与环境研究中的地位日益重要，然而当前研究数据基础设施在支持AI工作流程方面的适用性仍缺乏明确界定。尽管FAIR原则为科学数据管理提供了基础，但它们并未明确涉及当数据集用于训练、评估和部署AI模型时所产生的若干要求。本文提出了一个以实践为导向的框架，用于评估和改进分布式地球与环境数据基础设施中研究数据的AI就绪度。该框架通过结构化、社区驱动的流程开发而成，首先回顾了现有文献和就绪度框架，并结合对应用机器学习方法的科学家进行的有限调查所获得的反馈。其主要内容是由一个代表数据提供方等多学科背景的专家组所塑造的。
tldr: 该论文提出了一个社区驱动的实践性框架，用于评估和提升地球与环境科学研究中数据的“AI就绪度”，弥补了FAIR原则在AI模型训练、评估与部署场景下数据要求的不足。
en_tdlr: This paper presents a community-driven, practically motivated framework for assessing and improving the AI-readiness of research data in distributed Earth and environmental data infrastructures, addressing requirements for AI model training, evaluation, and deployment that go beyond the FAIR principles.
